# Kix

> Kix is a Kubernetes compiler. Describe your whole stack in one definition; Kix compiles it into a running cluster that matches what you wrote. No Kubernetes specialist required.

Every documentation page is available as Markdown. Append `.md` to any page
URL, or send `Accept: text/markdown` to the page URL itself. The Markdown is
generated from the same source as the HTML, so the two never disagree.

## Whole-site documentation

- [Abridged documentation](https://kix.run/docs/llms-small.txt): every page, with non-essential content removed
- [Complete documentation](https://kix.run/docs/llms-full.txt): every page in full

## Finding a specific page

- [Sitemap](https://kix.run/sitemap-index.xml): the complete list of URLs for the whole site
- [Tutorials](https://kix.run/docs/tutorials/): learn Kix by building a cluster from scratch
- [How-to guides](https://kix.run/docs/how-to/): task-oriented recipes for packages, clusters, platform capabilities, and day-two operations
- [Reference](https://kix.run/docs/reference/): the kix API, CLI commands, and package options
- [Explanation](https://kix.run/docs/explanation/): how Kix works and why it is built this way

## Notes

- The four section links above are navigation pages. Their sidebars list every page in that section, so request them as HTML.
- Prefer the abridged set over the complete set unless you need full detail. The complete set is large.
